stops.name: Preikestolhytta
stops.detail: The platform is only accessible via a hiking trail from the end of the signposted road at Preikestolhytta.

stops.name: Refsvatn
stops.detail: The lake Refsvatn lies below the Preikestolhytta.

stops.name: Urskarhöhe
stops.detail: The path first leads steeply up a ridge and then almost level across boardwalks through marshy forest to the Urskar height (418 m above sea level), through the Krogabekkmyra swamp and from there up over a boulder field to the Neverdalsskaret (532 m above sea level).

stops.name: Tjødnane
stops.detail: Passing the Tjødnane group of lakes, one finally reaches the unsecured platform via a section secured with stairs and railings.

stops.name: Preikestolen
stops.detail: Preikestolen or Prekestolen (Norwegian for the pulpit or literally the preaching chair) is a natural rock platform (rock pulpit) in Ryfylke in the Norwegian county of Rogaland and a tourist attraction with a wide view over the Lysefjord and adjacent mountains.
